title: ALL ( col1, col2 ) removes the filters on both columns and leaves a third column's filter
query: EVALUATE CALCULATETABLE ( ROW ( "r", CALCULATE ( [Sales Amount], ALL ( 'Product'[Color], 'Product'[Category] ) ) ), 'Product'[Color] = "Red", 'Product'[Category] = "Accessories", 'Product'[Product] IN { "Bike", "Lock" } )

source.quote: Removes all filters from the specified columns in the table; all other filters on other columns in the table still apply.
source.supports: ALL ( Column, Column ) removes the filters from the listed columns; filters on other columns still apply

derivation: Outer filters: Red, Accessories, and Product in { Bike, Lock } (together: no product). Removing the Color and Category filters leaves Product in { Bike, Lock }: 400 + 80 = 480. Removing only Color would give Lock 80; only Category, Bike 400.
notes: SUM of a fixed decimal (currency) column is taken to be a fixed decimal, as in the seed cases.
